Abbreviations & Glossary Part 1

AIM
Alabama Identity Management — the ALSDE single sign-on portal.
ALSDE
Alabama State Department of Education.
APLDS
Alabama Principal Leadership Development System — used by Principals and Assistant Principals to create, implement, and evaluate their Professional Learning Plans (PLP). Housed inside Teaching Effectiveness.
Application Access Rule
An access rule assigned in the Education Directory that grants users access to specific AIM portal applications.
Certification of Completion
Certification of successful completion of all APLDS program requirements under the School Principal Leadership and Mentoring Act (§§ 16-6I).
Continuum
A named set of indicators — e.g., Educator, School Administrator, Librarian, Counselor.
District Options
Teaching and leadership standards selected by Central Office at the start of each annual evaluation year.
Education Directory
ALSDE application where AIM user profiles are stored and managed.

Abbreviations & Glossary Part 2

Evaluatee
A user being evaluated on a continuum (educator, central office staff, librarian, counselor, or leader).
Evaluator
A user facilitating the evaluation of an Evaluatee — typically a principal or central office staff member.
Evidence
A set of qualifying information supported by comments and documents showing progress on a PLP.
Goal Indicator
An indicator selected for the PLP and its related supporting Evidence.
Indicator
A subset of teaching or leadership standards related to a specific set of practices.
LEAD
Used by Central Office staff for self-evaluations. Housed inside Teaching Effectiveness.
LEA
Local Education Authority — a school district.
PLP
Professional Learning Plan — a focused plan for improvement on selected goal indicators.
Review Year
The school year for which an evaluation is done (e.g., review year 2024 = school year 2024–2025).
Reviewer
A district central office user (superintendent or other CO staff).
School Administrator
A Principal or Assistant Principal evaluating under APLDS.
TE
Teaching Effectiveness application.

APLDS Overview

🏫

The Alabama Principal Leadership Development System (APLDS) application provides a place for LEAD Evaluatees — Principals and Assistant Principals — to record information as they complete the Alabama Principal Leadership Development System evaluation process.

Principals Assistant Principals Housed in Teaching Effectiveness Not affiliated with Cognia

Login via the AIM Portal

  1. 1Go to aim.alsde.edu, enter your AIM username and password, and click Log In.
  2. 2Select the Teaching Effectiveness tile from the available AIM applications. This navigates you into the TE/APLDS application.
⚠ Note: The Education Directory Application Editor for your LEA is responsible for configuring your AIM profile to access Teaching Effectiveness. If you cannot log in or cannot see the TE tile, contact your ED Application Editor.

For AIM or Education Directory assistance, contact the ALSDE Service Desk: servicedesk@alsde.edu  |  334-694-4777

Application Access Rule Assignment

To access the APLDS annual evaluation process, users must have a TE application access rule assigned in the Education Directory by the LEA’s Application Editor.

Access RulePositionFunctionality
TE App School CertifierPrincipals & Assistant PrincipalsAccess the APLDS annual evaluation process as Evaluatees.
TE App System CertifierSuperintendents & Assistant SuperintendentsAccess the APLDS annual evaluation process as Evaluators/Reviewers.
⚠ Important: Users should only be assigned one Teaching Effectiveness application access rule. Multiple rules can cause conflicts in the application.

Menu

The menu appears at the top of all pages in the TE/APLDS application, providing quick access to key dashboards and pages.

  • Provides access to: Self-Assessment Dashboard, Professional Learning Plan Dashboard, Evidence Dashboard, Help Page, and more.
  • Menu items vary by role — Educator, Principal, Central Office Reviewer, etc.
  • Selecting a menu item navigates directly to that page.

Technical Help and Guidance

Help and Guidance panels are available on every page but collapsed by default. Click the help or guide icon near the bottom-right corner to expand.

  • Panels are contextual — content is specific to the screen you are currently viewing.
  • Content can change by review year.
  • Technical Help — directions on how to use the TE/APLDS application.
  • Guidance — information on the activities the Evaluatee is performing. Begins with a "General Guidance" heading; may also include sections from SDE, your district, and your school.
  • Selecting another icon closes the current panel. Selecting the same icon again closes it.

Review Year

APLDS organizes all information by Review Year, which corresponds to the academic school year.

Example Academic school year 2023–2024 = Review Year 2023–2024
  • When a new review year begins, school districts must select their district options before Evaluatees can start the annual evaluation process.
  • Evaluatees can use the Review Year dropdown to view data from previous review years.

Notifications

🔔

Notifications appear beneath the menu on the Teaching Effectiveness dashboard. They may include information about:

  • Scheduled site maintenance
  • End-of-year closeout dates
  • Other TE/APLDS events
✓ Tip: Always check for notifications when you log in to Teaching Effectiveness.

Help Page

❓

The Help Page contains links to tutorial guides and training videos for TE/APLDS.

Access it anytime from the main menu.

User Settings
Navigate to the Settings page.

User Settings: Primary System & Site

📅 Must be completed at the start of every annual evaluation year

On login, the application checks whether the Evaluatee’s Primary System and Primary Site are selected for the current review year. If not, users are automatically directed to the Settings page.

  • Dropdowns populate from the sites assigned to the user’s AIM profile in the Education Directory.
  • Primary System auto-populates based on the Evaluatee’s assigned system in the Education Directory.
  • Settings cannot be selected until the District Office has selected the district options for the year.
  • After saving, users are redirected to the ATGP Evaluation Dashboard and will not be auto-directed to Settings on future logins.

User Settings: Selecting a Continuum

📅 Must be completed at the start of every annual evaluation year

On login, the application checks whether a continuum has been selected. If not, the Evaluatee is automatically directed to the Settings page.

⚠ Starting 2024–2025: Principals and Assistant Principals must select the Administrator continuum.

The continuum cannot be changed once the annual evaluation has been started.

User Settings: Selecting an Evaluator

📅 Must be completed at the start of every annual evaluation year

Before Evaluatees can select their Evaluators/Reviewers, those users must first log in to Teaching Effectiveness so they appear in the Evaluator dropdown.

Note: Evaluators/Reviewers are listed under the system and site they are assigned to in the Education Directory.

User Settings: Education & Experience

📅 Must be completed at the start of every annual evaluation year

Users must enter their Teacher Certificate Holder (TCH) information on the Settings page. This information is not locked and can be updated at any time.

  • Enter your TCH number and answer questions about certification status.
  • If you hold an approved certification, you will be asked whether you are working in the same teaching field — with follow-up questions if applicable.
  • If you don’t know your TCH number, it can be found in PowerSchool.

APLDS ATGP Evaluation Dashboard

The ATGP Evaluation Dashboard shows the steps currently available to an Evaluatee. Each step unlocks only after the prerequisite step is complete.

1
School Administrator Position Selection — Available immediately after user settings are saved.
↓
2
Professional Learning Plan — Available once Position Selection is complete.
↓
3
Certification of Stipend Eligibility — Available once the PLP is complete.
↓
4
Professional Commitment Evidence — Available after Certification of Stipend Eligibility is complete.
↓
5
Certification of Completion — Available after Professional Commitment Evidence is complete.

School Administrator Position Selection

Available as soon as the Evaluatee has saved user settings. Evaluatees must select at least one of the following:

🏅
